name: A11 Ollama Check
description: Vérifie qu'Ollama est accessible quand on modifie la config LLM

then.command: powershell -Command "try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 5; Write-Host \"Ollama: $($r.models.Count) models\" } catch { Write-Host \"Ollama: DOWN\" }"
